prompts.front:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: German technical presentation plate for a GitHub hardware wiki. EDIT TARGET is the attached local image UFI_Headless-front.png, the CURRENT v1.0 PCB TOP view. Preserve the entire actual board photograph/render faithfully: same orientation, all connectors, component shapes, positions, traces, existing silkscreen and copper, no component additions/removals, no mirroring. Add ONLY professional annotation overlays and an expanded neutral off-white/light grey margin around the original image. Large landscape high-resolution output, ideally 3840x2160. Title: "UFI Headless v1.0 · Vorderseite". Subtitle: "Anschlüsse und zentrale Baugruppen". Use clean dark navy text, white rectangular callout cards, subtle corners, thin teal leader lines ending in small dots at the exact indicated items; amber accents for power connections. Keep labels outside the board and the entire board unobscured, leader lines routed neatly with minimal crossings. Preserve enough of the original board image to read the silkscreen. Exact German label texts, number badges 01–18:
01 "J22 · LAN / Ethernet" points to the large silver RJ45 enclosure at x625 y110 in the ORIGINAL 1724x930 image.
02 "J2 · 12-V-Eingang" points to black DC barrel jack at x500 y110.
03 "J17 · Netzteil-Eingang" points to upper of the two white vertical sockets on left edge x425 y163.
04 "J8 · Commodore IEC" points to small black left edge pin header x418 y451.
05 "J6 · PC / Shugart, 34-polig" points to wide upper LEFT bottom black header x620 y736.
06 "J14 · Apple Disk II" points to smaller LOWER LEFT bottom black header x598 y829. This is Disk II, not Mac.
07 "J19 · Sync-Sensor" points to small white connector x780 y818 just right of lower left black header.
08 "J3 · Laufwerksversorgung" points to taller white socket at bottom center x877 y812.
09 "J23 · Macintosh 3,5 Zoll" points to smaller LOWER RIGHT bottom black header x1137 y828. This is Mac, not Disk II.
10 "J7 · Amiga-Laufwerk" points to wide upper RIGHT bottom black header x1164 y735.
11 "J12 · Frontbedienung" points to tall shrouded black header on RIGHT edge x1290 y360.
12 "J21 · Logikanalysator" points to upright unshrouded double-row header immediately left of J12, x1151 y351.
13 "J4 · SWD / Programmierung" points to small double row header at upper right x1200 y113.
14 "J1 · USB-C" points to small silver USB-C at top edge x1004 y103.
15 "U5 · STM32H723" points to large central square MCU x861 y397.
16 "U11 · 8-MB-PSRAM" points to small horizontal black 8-pin IC x1027 y561 marked U11, below/right of MCU. Do not point to adjacent U10.
17 "U15 · SD-NAND" points to horizontal grey memory component x883 y146 near top between W5500 and USB-C.
18 "U23 · W5500-Netzwerkcontroller" points to square black IC x769 y167 immediately right of RJ45 and left of U15.
Footer small: "Bauteilübersicht · Keine Kabel- oder Pinbelegungsanleitung". Avoid invented features, illegible text, labels inside connectors, duplicate numbers, or inaccurate leader endpoints. Use current correct reference only.
prompts.back:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: UFI_Headless-back.png, actual current UFI v1.0 PCB underside. Create a high-resolution German annotated hardware presentation slide matching a companion top view: light neutral outer margin, dark navy German typography, white rectangular labels with numbered teal badges, thin teal leader lines and endpoint dots, amber highlights for power. Title "UFI Headless v1.0 · Rückseite". Subtitle "Batterie, Anschlusspositionen und Bestückungsdruck". Preserve the ORIGINAL board exactly including its real mirrored underside orientation, size proportions, traces, all solder pads, existing lettering, mounting holes, CR2032 holder. Do not flip, redraw, add or remove any board component, pad or printed text. Extend only the background for annotation space. Ideally 3840x2160 landscape. Keep labels outside the board; never obscure its silkscreen, solder pads or battery. The original reference dimensions are 1724x930; use these exact target coordinates for leader lines. IMPORTANT: the back view is naturally mirrored relative to the front: Apple Disk II is lower RIGHT and Macintosh is lower LEFT. Keep this correct. Label numbers intentionally match companion front view; do not renumber:
03 "J17 · Netzteil-Eingang" -> right edge top vertical 4 solder pads x1278 y177, next to labels 5V/GND/12V.
04 "J8 · Commodore IEC" -> right edge middle vertical six solder pads x1297 y453.
05 "J6 · PC / Shugart, 34-polig" -> upper bottom RIGHT long double row solder pads centered x1090 y724.
06 "J14 · Apple Disk II" -> lower bottom RIGHT double row solder pads centered x1115 y810.
07 "J19 · Sync-Sensor" -> three solder pads at bottom center-right x936 y814 labelled 5V/GND/SYNC.
08 "J3 · Laufwerksversorgung" -> four solder pads just left of bottom center x843 y801 labelled 5V/GND/GND/12V.
09 "J23 · Macintosh 3,5 Zoll" -> lower bottom LEFT double row solder pads centered x606 y810 (CA0/CA1 and related text).
10 "J7 · Amiga-Laufwerk" -> upper bottom LEFT long double row solder pads centered x570 y723.
11 "J12 · Frontbedienung" -> double vertical row at left edge x450 y370, labels ACT/ERR/USB/FDD/PWR and related.
12 "J21 · Logikanalysator" -> two vertical rows at x575 y354, RDY/DENS/STEP/DIR etc.
19 "BT1 · CR2032-Batteriehalter" -> circular grey/silver coin-cell holder center-right x943 y540. Do not claim a battery is installed.
20 "Revision und Datum" / second smaller line "v1.0 · 2026-10-25" -> printed actual silkscreen text around x858 y264.
Footer: "Ansicht von unten · Gegenüber der Vorderseite spiegelverkehrte Anschlusslage". Use crisp readable accents/umlauts, neat non-overlapping cards, minimal leader crossings and unique correct labels; preserve image fidelity. These are explanatory callouts, not a wiring diagram.
